name: granular-git-commit-push
description: Safely reconstruct visible code from screenshots when requested, inspect Git changes, create granular one-file-per-commit history, synchronize with the remote, and push without destructive history rewriting.

interface.longDescription: A Codex skill-only plugin for reconstructing visible files from screenshots when requested, inspecting real Git state, planning granular commits, protecting secrets and staged work, syncing safely, and recovering from partial Git failures.
defaultPrompt: Reconstruct visible files, then commit separately.
Recover my failed granular push safely.
